examples.title: String art
examples.description: Eighty-four straight lines, twenty-one in each corner, in thirteen of MODE 0's sixteen inks, bend into curves the way thread does on a pinboard.

examples.title: Roman numerals
examples.description: Type a number from 1 to 3999 and a WHILE and WEND loop spells it in Roman numerals; 1985, the year the CPC6128 came out, is MCMLXXXV.

examples.title: Squash
examples.description: Keep the ball in play with Z and X; every return scores a point and a beep, and SPACE serves a new game after a miss.

manuals.title: Amstrad CPC6128 User Instructions
manuals.note: Amstrad, 1985, with the full Locomotive BASIC 1.1 reference; PDF scan

manuals.title: Amstrad CPC 464 Käyttäjän opas
manuals.note: Finnish user guide for the 6128's older sibling (Toptronics, 1984): the same Locomotive BASIC, without the 6128's later additions such as FRAME; PDF scan
